pressure_feedback.basis: initial measured spatial support-load profile; common window transports material through fixed curve stations; conserved side load

fixed_spatial_action.action: stationary captured spatial curve; common window advances all integral angles; parallel transported initial material phase; tangential motion allowed
fixed_spatial_action.material_correspondence: initial smooth-curve arc intervals captured once and shifted together; physical rods and integration cells remain 64.5 mm
fixed_spatial_action.observer_caveat: legacy rolling-motion estimate is diagnostic only and does not gate or establish progress

wrap_feedback.action: pipe-axis front wrap goal located by stable actual bearing; local radial and tilt curve field plus bounded material phase from physical FK residual

physical_FK_prediction_registration.assumption: short-time physical FK prediction registered to measured bearing body pose; bearing is not actually pinned and physical root is never assigned

wrap_feedback.bounded_parameter_solver: four normalized curve/frame increments solved within remaining parameter bounds; reject predicted residual increase
wrap_feedback.feedback_truth: simulation actual world nodes, body/root orientation, measured cylinder load, target/source geometric membership; physical root is observed only; initial material normals fixed
wrap_feedback.long_term_goal: original fixed route and single inherited target helix about +Y; actual anchors bound only local connection, no unrestricted actual-pose overwrite

prediction_registration.assumption: short-time physical FK prediction registered to measured bearing body pose; bearing is not actually pinned and physical root is never assigned

compact_curve_action.action: fixed route continues current hook tangent and handedness; future axial pitch decreases smoothly over three rods, then stays 180 mm
compact_curve_action.initial_material_normals: same CLOSE calibration as N15; retained without actual-q refit
compact_curve_action.compactness_caveat: ideal uniform-helix totals exclude inherited hook and transition; actual wrapping requires dynamics

planned_route_spec.origin: CLOSE fixed spatial curve, same handed tangent continuation to one compact target helix
planned_route_spec.material_window: fixed captured initial curve arclength intervals; one common shift
